EQUIPMENT / TOOLS & ACCESSORIES

ROV tools & accessories.

The tool decides what an ROV can do. Each one must match the vehicle, its power supply and the working depth.

Equipment / Tools & accessories

THE RANGE

Five groups. One question first.

Which vehicle carries it, what powers it and how deep it must work. Figures are from the manufacturer brochure.

01 / 5 MODELS

Manipulator arms

Grippers and multi-function arms for handling, sampling and light intervention.

  • F-ARM-S · single-function · arm span 300 mm
  • F-ARM-D · two-function · arm span 266 mm
  • F-ARM-3A · three-function · arm span 570 mm
  • F-ARM-4A · four-function · arm span 700 mm
  • F-ARM-5A · five-function · arm span 610 mm
02 / 6 MODELS

Intervention tools

Breaking, grinding, chiselling, drilling, cleaning and cutting tools. Most need a hydraulic or high-pressure water supply.

  • UWBreaking · breaker · brochure working depth ≥40 m
  • UWGrinding · grinder · rated speed 2,500 r/min
  • UWChisel · chisel · working pressure 100–140 bar
  • UWDrill · drill · working pressure 70–140 bar
  • UWWashing · cleaning unit · impact pressure ≥30 MPa
  • UWCutting · cutter · working pressure 105–140 bar
03 / 4 MODELS

Measurement & sampling

Sensors and samplers for locating, measuring and recording.

  • UWRadar · underwater radar · 3.8 kg in air
  • F-LM50 · short-range laser measuring device · brochure range 50 cm
  • IJTracer · ink-jet tracer · 3 kg without fluorescent ink
  • WB6X100 · water sampler · weight to be confirmed
04 / 6 MODELS

Thrusters

Replacement and upgrade thrusters, including magnetic-coupling models.

  • F-PROP-6A / 6B · rated thrust 6 kg
  • F-PROP-10 · rated thrust 10 kg
  • F-TM-20B · magnetic coupling · 20 kg
  • F-TM-40A · magnetic coupling · 40 kg
  • F-TM-60A · magnetic coupling · 60 kg
  • F-TM-150 · magnetic coupling · 150 kg
05 / 4 MODELS

Release hooks

Release devices for deploying or recovering loads.

  • F-DT100 · release hook · 100 kg capacity
  • F-DT500 · release hook · 500 kg capacity
  • F-FDT100 · buoyancy release · 100 kg capacity
  • F-EDT100 · electric release · 100 kg capacity

COMPATIBILITY

Match the tool to the vehicle.

The brochure does not publish a tool-to-vehicle matrix. Compatibility is confirmed for each enquiry against the supplied vehicle version.

Tool compatibility checks
GroupWhat to confirmCompatible vehicles
Manipulator armsMounting point, payload and trim, electrical interface and controlConfirmed on enquiry
Intervention toolsHydraulic or water supply, pressure, reaction forces and vehicle stabilityConfirmed on enquiry
Measurement & samplingMounting, power, data link and recording softwareConfirmed on enquiry
ThrustersVehicle model, connector, control electronics and thrust allocationConfirmed on enquiry
Release hooksLoad, release method, trigger signal and recovery planConfirmed on enquiry

Some brochure entries need correction or confirmation before ordering, including the WB6X100 weight.

QUESTIONS

Ordering tools and accessories.

Can tools be ordered separately?

Tools and accessories can be quoted with a vehicle or on their own. Availability, lead time and export conditions are confirmed per enquiry.

Will they fit another manufacturer’s ROV?

Mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and communication interfaces differ between vehicles. Fitting to another brand needs interface drawings and is assessed case by case.

Which vehicles carry hydraulic tools?

Hydraulic tools need a suitable power unit and enough payload and stability to react the tool forces. Light work-class vehicles such as the R-150 are the starting point; confirm the specific tool and vehicle combination.
